mapper.select:
select prd.BOOKSET_ID id, IFNULL(prd.BOOKSET_NAME,prd.BOOKSET_FULLNAME) text from bok_bookset prd where 1=1
AND prd.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE in
#{acctSubjectType}
AND (prd.BOOKSET_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR prd.BOOKSET_NAME like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR prd.BOOKSET_FULLNAME like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%'))
order by prd.BOOKSET_ID
